title: CRM-to-Microsoft Teams Client Onboarding Automation
summary: A new client form creates the CRM record and a dedicated Teams channel, then posts a templated update whenever the client moves stage.
headline: New client? Their Teams channel is ready
problem: Setting up a collaboration space for each new client, and keeping everyone updated on progress, was manual.
solution: A form submission in GoHighLevel creates the contact and opportunity. Zapier then provisions a private Teams channel with a standard name and description. Each later stage change in the CRM posts a templated message to that client's channel automatically.
highlights: Contact and opportunity created from a form
role: Sole engineer. I designed the flow and built the CRM automations and Zapier integrations, including the Microsoft Graph calls.
